tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Plain lists, full-bleed content and the iOS screen behind everything. A soft grey in Light rather than pure white, so use the Lumen colour, not Color(.systemBackground).

tokens.name: bg-grouped
tokens.usage: Behind inset-grouped lists and settings screens. One step greyer than Color(.systemGroupedBackground) in Light.

tokens.name: bg-window
tokens.usage: macOS window content area behind the floating sidebar and inspector.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Rows and cards on bg-grouped; sheet content. An off-white in Light, never pure white.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Content nested inside a surface (a field inside a card, a popover row).

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Thin control fills: switch track off, slider track. SwiftUI: Color(.systemFill).

tokens.name: fill-secondary
tokens.usage: Medium fills: grabbers, progress tracks.

tokens.name: fill-tertiary
tokens.usage: Large fills: segmented-control track, search field outside glass, pressed row.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text and glyphs on every ground and on glass. SwiftUI: .primary.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Subtitles, row values, captions on bg, bg-grouped, surface and surface-raised (4.5:1 or better in both themes). Darker than SwiftUI .secondary on purpose.

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholder text, disabled labels and chevrons only. Below 4.5:1 by design; never for information a person must read.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: 0.5pt hairlines between list rows and toolbar groups. SwiftUI: Color(.separator).

tokens.name: separator-opaque
tokens.usage: Hairlines that must not tint with what is behind them (table headers on macOS).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The app tint, a calm slate blue: prominent button fills, selected tab glyph, switch on, slider fill. White text on it: 5.3:1 light, 5.5:1 dark. Set as AccentColor in the asset catalog.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Tinted text and glyphs (links, plain buttons, toolbar items) on bg, bg-grouped, surface, surface-raised and glass. 5.3:1+ light, 6.0:1+ dark.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected sidebar row and selection highlight. Opaque so its text holds contrast on any ground or glass: accent-text on it is 5.1:1 light, 5.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent-soft-glass
tokens.usage: Web stand-in for tinted glass on bordered buttons over surface or surface-raised; accent-text on it stays 5:1+ in both themes. SwiftUI: .glassEffect(.regular.tint(accentSoft)).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on iPad and Mac: 3pt solid, 3:1+ on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations, positive deltas, paired with checkmark.circle. Text-safe on bg, bg-grouped and surface.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Recoverable problems, paired with exclamationmark.triangle. Text-safe on bg, bg-grouped and surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors, paired with a word or xmark.octagon. Text-safe on bg, bg-grouped and surface.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Regular glass, web stand-in for .glassEffect(.regular): tab bars, toolbars, search fields, glass buttons. Frosted enough that labels read over busy content. In SwiftUI never paint this: use the system material.

tokens.name: glass-fill-thick
tokens.usage: Thick glass, web stand-in for panels that hold text: partial-height sheets, sidebars, menus and popovers. Content stays readable while a hint of what is behind shows through.

tokens.name: glass-lens
tokens.usage: The small glass lens that marks a selection inside a glass or filled control: the selected tab, the segmented-control thumb.

tokens.name: glass-stroke
tokens.usage: 0.5pt rim on glass stand-ins; also the inner ring on the cover.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: 1pt top specular edge on glass stand-ins and prominent buttons.

tokens.name: glass-sheen
tokens.usage: Soft top-down light across prominent buttons in web stand-ins, fading out above the label so white text keeps its contrast.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims content behind a large-detent sheet or alert.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: ios-headline
styles.usage: .headline — inline nav titles, row titles that lead, button labels.

styles.name: ios-body
styles.usage: .body — default for all reading text and list rows.
styles.sample: Your photos sync across every device signed in to this account.

styles.name: ios-footnote
styles.sample: Turning this off stops background refresh.

styles.name: mac-large-title
styles.usage: .largeTitle.bold() on Mac — onboarding and empty-state headings.

styles.name: mac-title2
styles.usage: .title2 on Mac — group headings in settings.

styles.name: mac-body
styles.usage: .body on Mac — sidebar items, table cells, controls.

styles.name: mac-callout
styles.usage: .callout on Mac — help text beside controls.

styles.name: numeric-display
styles.usage: .system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded) scaled up, .monospacedDigit() — stats, timers, widgets.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside compact controls; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; HStack default for toolbar items; glass container spacing.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding on Mac; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: iPhone layout margin; list row horizontal padding; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: iPad and Mac layout margin; sheet content padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a scroll view.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above a section heading; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on onboarding and Mac welcome windows.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Small Mac controls, badges, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Text fields and pop-up buttons on Mac; app-icon tiles in rows.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, menus, popovers; inner shapes inside radius-l containers (radius-l minus 8pt padding).

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Inset-grouped list sections, cards, Mac floating sidebar.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets and large glass panels on iPhone; the outermost container a screen shows.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero tiles and onboarding panels on iPad; the cover's outer panel.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Capsules: buttons, tab bars, search fields, segmented controls, toolbar groups. SwiftUI: .capsule.

tokens.name: hit-ios
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on iPhone and iPad (both axes).

tokens.name: hit-mac
tokens.usage: Default control height and minimum click target on Mac.

tokens.name: control-large
tokens.usage: Height of .controlSize(.large) prominent buttons pinned to the bottom of a screen.

tokens.name: tab-bar
tokens.usage: Floating glass tab bar height on iPhone.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur radius for web glass stand-ins only.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Floating glass: tab bars, toolbars, sidebars. The system draws this for real glass; use for stand-ins.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Selected segment thumb, switch knob, cards that lift on hover (Mac).

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets and popovers above content.
